extDescription.message: Intercept and modify HTTP traffic from DevTools.

cause_user.message: You detached the debugger. Press Attach to intercept again.

cause_panel_closed.message: The panel was closed and the debugger was detached.

cause_canceled_by_user.message: It was canceled from Chrome's warning bar. Press Reconnect to attach again.

cause_target_closed.message: The tab was closed or navigated to a page that cannot be debugged. Press Reconnect.

cause_already_attached.message: Another debugger (another extension or tool) is already attached to this tab. Close it and press Reconnect.

cause_restricted_page.message: Chrome does not allow debugging this page (internal or store pages). Open another page.

cause_unknown.message: The debugger was detached for an unknown reason. Press Reconnect.

error_invalid_message.message: Invalid message between the panel and the extension. Reload the panel.

error_not_attached.message: The debugger is not attached. Press Attach first.

error_already_attached.message: Another debugger is already attached to this tab. Close it and press Reconnect.

error_restricted_page.message: Chrome does not allow debugging this page. Open another page.

error_unknown_paused_id.message: That pause was already resolved (continued, expired or abandoned).

error_cdp_error.message: Chrome rejected the change; the request continued unmodified.

empty_not_attached.message: Attach the debugger to intercept this tab's traffic.

error_no_tab.message: The inspected tab could not be identified. Close and reopen DevTools.

site_none.message: This page has no site (opaque origin): traffic is captured but no rules apply.

empty_traffic_body.message: Attach the debugger and reload the page to capture its requests.

empty_rules_body.message: A rule pauses, mocks or delays only the requests that match a condition.

empty_queue_body.message: When a rule pauses a request, it shows up here so you can edit it.

error_disconnected.message: The panel lost its connection to Nahual. It will reconnect in a few seconds.

error_rule_invalid.message: The rule has errors. Check the highlighted fields.

error_unknown_rule.message: That rule no longer exists. It may have been deleted in another tab.

error_settings_invalid.message: That setting is not valid. Check the allowed range.

error_storage_quota.message: Out of storage space. Delete rules or shrink mock bodies.

error_edit_invalid.message: The edit has errors. Check the highlighted fields.

error_body_unavailable.message: The body is no longer available: Chrome dropped it or it never existed.

error_no_site.message: This page has no site, so rules cannot be assigned to it.

notice_settings_reset.message: Some saved settings were invalid and were reset to their defaults.

traffic_at_cap.message: History is full: the oldest exchanges are dropped (limit 2,000).

filter_regex_invalid.message: Invalid regex: the last valid filter is kept.

filter_status_invalid.message: Use codes (404) or classes (4xx) separated by commas.

empty_traffic_reload.message: Reload the page to capture its requests.

empty_traffic_filtered_body.message: Change or clear the filters to see more exchanges.

detail_url_truncated.message: The URL is very long and is shown truncated.

body_unavailable_pending.message: The response has not finished arriving yet.

body_unavailable_binary.message: Binary body: only its metadata is shown.

body_unavailable_tooLarge.message: Body larger than 5 MB: only its metadata is shown.

body_unavailable_evicted.message: Chrome already dropped this body from memory. Repeat the request to see it.

body_json_invalid.message: The body is not valid JSON; you can still continue.

confirm_continue_all_body.message: There are $1 unapplied edits. Continuing all will discard them.

rule_conditions_none.message: No conditions: the prefilter is enough.

rule_prefilter_regex_hint.message: Regular expression over the full URL.

rule_stage_request_hint.message: Before the request goes to the network.

rule_stage_response_hint.message: When the response arrives, before the page gets it.

empty_rules_no_site.message: This page has no site: open your app to create rules for it.

settings_timeout_hint.message: Between 5 and 300 s. When it expires, the request continues unchanged.

settings_timeout_range.message: The timeout must be a whole number between 5 and 300 s.

shortcut_continue_selected.message: Shortcut to continue the selected item: $1

toast_apply_failed.message: The change could not be applied: the request continued unchanged.

toast_queue_released.message: The debugger was released: paused requests continued unchanged.

error_request_gone.message: The request no longer exists (the page navigated or closed).

notice_rules_invalid.message: $1 saved rules were invalid and were ignored.

notice_rules_version.message: The saved rules are from an unknown version and will not be used.

rule_error_regex_invalid.message: The regex is not valid: check parentheses and brackets.

rule_error_header_name.message: Invalid header name: no spaces or special characters.

rule_error_header_value.message: The value cannot contain line breaks.

rule_error_status.message: The status must be between 100 and 599.

rule_error_range.message: The minimum cannot be greater than the maximum.

rule_error_condition_stage.message: This condition does not exist in this stage.

rule_error_body_too_large.message: The body is too large (1 MB in a rule, 5 MB from the queue).

rule_error_delay.message: The delay must be a whole number between 1 and 60,000 ms.

rule_error_jsonpath.message: The JSONPath is not valid. It must start with $.

rule_error_too_many_rules.message: There are already 500 rules: delete one to create another.

rule_error_stage_field.message: This field cannot be edited in this stage.

rule_error_url.message: The URL must be absolute (http or https).

onboarding_bar_title.message: Chrome will show a yellow bar

onboarding_bar_body.message: When attaching, Chrome shows “Nahual started debugging this browser”. That is expected: Nahual uses the Chrome debugger to see and pause this tab’s traffic. You can release it any time from the panel or the bar.

onboarding_data_body.message: While attached, Nahual sees all of this tab’s traffic: URLs, headers and bodies, including cookies and tokens. Only while the panel is open.

onboarding_data_mask.message: Sensitive values (Authorization, Cookie, tokens) are masked until you press “Show”.

onboarding_local_body.message: Nahual has no server and makes no requests of its own. History lives in memory and is cleared when you close the panel; only your rules are saved, in this browser.

status_global_paused.message: Nahual is paused: rules are not applied; capture continues.

solution_restricted_page.message: Open your app in a normal tab (http or https) and try again.

solution_already_attached.message: Close the other tool using the debugger on this tab and press Reconnect.

solution_unknown.message: Press Reconnect. If it happens again, reload the tab.

settings_auto_attach_hint.message: Turn it off to always attach manually.

settings_auto_attach_no_consent.message: It takes effect after your first “Attach”.

action_kind_pause_hint.message: Stops the request and puts it in the queue to edit it.

action_kind_mock_hint.message: At Request it responds without touching the network; at Response it replaces the response.

action_kind_fail_hint.message: The page receives a network error.

action_kind_delay_hint.message: The request continues unchanged after the delay; the rest of the traffic does not wait.

action_kind_log_hint.message: Continues unchanged and marks the exchange in the history.

toast_rule_moved.message: Rule “$1” is now at position $2 of $3.

cors_cause_missing_allow_origin.message: The server did not send Access-Control-Allow-Origin, so the browser does not let $1 read the response.

cors_fix_missing_allow_origin.message: On the server: respond with Access-Control-Allow-Origin: $1 (also on the preflight, if any).

cors_cause_origin_mismatch.message: The server allows a different origin (or several values) in Access-Control-Allow-Origin, not $1.

cors_fix_origin_mismatch.message: On the server: return exactly Access-Control-Allow-Origin: $1, a single value.

cors_cause_method_not_allowed.message: The preflight does not allow the $3 method.

cors_fix_method_not_allowed.message: On the server: add $3 to Access-Control-Allow-Methods (* does not work with credentials).

cors_cause_header_not_allowed.message: The preflight does not allow the $2 header.

cors_fix_header_not_allowed.message: On the server: add the headers the app requests to Access-Control-Allow-Headers (* does not work with credentials).

cors_cause_preflight_status.message: The preflight (OPTIONS) responded with a non-2xx status.

cors_fix_preflight_status.message: On the server: answer OPTIONS with 204 without requiring authentication, before any filter that returns 401 or 404.

cors_cause_wildcard_with_credentials.message: The server responded Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * and the request carries credentials; credentials require the exact origin.

cors_fix_wildcard_with_credentials.message: On the server: return Access-Control-Allow-Origin: $1 and Access-Control-Allow-Credentials: true.

cors_cause_missing_allow_credentials.message: The request carries credentials and the server did not send Access-Control-Allow-Credentials: true.

cors_fix_missing_allow_credentials.message: On the server: add Access-Control-Allow-Credentials: true along with Access-Control-Allow-Origin: $1.

cors_cause_preflight_redirect.message: The preflight (OPTIONS) responded with a redirect; the browser does not follow it.

cors_fix_preflight_redirect.message: On the server: answer OPTIONS directly with 204, without redirecting (e.g. to https or another path).

cors_preflight_not_observed_help.message: Nahual did not see the preflight (for example, if it attached mid-request). Repeat the request with the panel open to see it.

cors_not_relaxable_null_origin.message: Cannot be relaxed: the app has no exact origin (null origin, local file or sandboxed iframe).

cors_not_relaxable_same_origin.message: Cannot be relaxed: the app and the API share the same origin.

cors_not_relaxable_unrecognized.message: Nahual cannot fix this cause from the browser; it requires a server change.

cors_not_relaxable_production.message: Cannot be relaxed: $1 is in your list of production origins.

cors_error_origin.message: Invalid origin: use scheme://host[:port], without a path.

cors_error_production_entry.message: Invalid entry: use an exact origin (https://app.company.com) or a subdomain pattern (https://*.company.com).

cors_error_duration.message: Invalid duration: choose 15 min, 1 h, 4 h or 8 h.

cors_production_list_invalid.message: The list of production origins has damaged entries. Review and save it in Settings: until then CORS cannot be relaxed.

cors_relax_credentials.message: The app sends credentials (cookies or HTTP authentication)

cors_relax_expose_none_seen.message: This origin has not returned headers to expose yet.

cors_relax_warning.message: The relaxation only exists in this browser and this tab: in staging and production it will fail until the server is fixed.

cors_relax_active.message: CORS relaxed for $1 in this tab. Repeat the request.

cors_relaxed_failed.message: This response could not be relaxed; it continued unchanged. Cause: $1

cors_relaxed_preflight.message: The server's preflight responded $1 and Nahual replaced it with a local 204.

cors_relaxed_preflight_local.message: Nahual answered the preflight locally (the server redirects OPTIONS).

cors_relaxed_already_valid.message: The server already responds correctly to this request: you can turn the relaxation off.

cors_state_idle.message: no effect: the page is on another origin

cors_ended_expired.message: A CORS relaxation expired and no longer applies.

cors_ended_detached.message: The CORS relaxation ended because the debugger was detached.

cors_ended_production.message: The CORS relaxation ended because its origin was marked as production.

cors_ended_restart.message: The CORS relaxation ended because Nahual restarted.

cors_credentials_learned.message: The request uses credentials: the relaxation now allows them. Repeat the request.

cors_issue_app_origin_invalid.message: The app origin is not valid.

cors_issue_app_origin_null.message: The app has no exact origin (null): it cannot be relaxed.

cors_issue_api_origin_invalid.message: The API origin is not valid.

cors_issue_same_origin.message: The app and the API share the same origin: there is no CORS to relax.

cors_issue_production_origin.message: That origin is in your production list.

cors_issue_production_list_invalid.message: The list of production origins has damaged entries: review and save it in Settings.

cors_issue_duration_invalid.message: Invalid duration: choose 15 min, 1 h, 4 h or 8 h.

cors_issue_limit_reached.message: There are already 10 relaxed API origins in this tab: turn one off.

cors_issue_already_relaxed.message: That API origin is already relaxed: turn it off to create another relaxation.

cors_issue_expose_header_invalid.message: Some Expose-Headers entry is invalid (no spaces, no * and at most 30).

error_relaxation_invalid.message: CORS could not be relaxed. Check the reasons below the button.

settings_production_hint.message: Nahual never relaxes CORS on these origins, neither as app nor as API.

settings_production_empty.message: The list is empty: Nahual does not guess what production is.

settings_production_add_hint.message: Exact origin (https://app.company.com) or subdomain pattern (https://*.company.com, does not include the root domain).

cors_report_warning.message: Note: Nahual only relaxes CORS in the debugging developer's browser. In staging and production these requests will fail until the server is configured like this.

cors_report_origins.message: Origins to allow (Access-Control-Allow-Origin, one exact origin per response):

cors_report_credentials_yes.message: Credentials: yes. Access-Control-Allow-Credentials: true is required, and never *.

cors_report_copy_manual.message: Could not copy automatically: the text is selected, copy it with Ctrl+C.

cors_report_empty_title.message: No blocked requests for this origin

cors_report_empty_body.message: The report is built from requests blocked by CORS or relaxed by Nahual. With the panel open, repeat the failing action in the app and open it again.

confirm_replace_draft_body.message: The editor has a rule with unsaved changes. If you continue, it is replaced by the draft from this request.

repeater_empty_body.message: Right-click a request in Traffic and choose "Send to repeater", or create an empty tab. Tabs live while DevTools is open: closing it discards them.

shortcut_desc_next_change.message: Go to the next diff change

shortcut_desc_prev_change.message: Go to the previous diff change

repeater_tabs_full.message: There are already 20 repeater tabs open. Close one to open another.

repeater_url_truncated.message: This request's URL was too long and was cut when captured: check it before sending.

repeater_mode_page_hint.message: Sent from the tab, with its cookies and origin, and through your rules.

repeater_mode_clean_hint.message: Sent from Nahual, without cookies or session, like a signed-out client.

repeater_page_unavailable.message: Page context unavailable: Nahual is not attached to the tab. Attach it or use the clean context.

repeater_header_forbidden.message: The browser does not let you set this header: it ignores it or sets its own.

repeater_body_original.message: Original body, not editable ($1, $2): it is resent intact.

repeater_body_none_unavailable.message: The original body is not text and Nahual no longer has it: the send will not reproduce it.

repeater_body_none_evicted.message: The original body is no longer available (dropped from history): the send will not reproduce it.

repeater_body_none_tooLarge.message: The original body is over 5 MB and is not kept: the send will not reproduce it.

repeater_no_result.message: You haven't sent this request yet.

repeater_preflight_blocked.message: The CORS preflight blocked the request (status $1).

repeater_relaxed.message: The development CORS relaxation acted on this send.

repeater_cors_blocked_detail.message: Open the request in Traffic to see the full CORS diagnosis.

repeater_not_sent_headers.message: Not sent as written (the browser does not allow it): $1

repeater_history_empty.message: Each send will show up here with its status, time and size.

repeater_history_dropped.message: $1 older sends were dropped (the 50 most recent are kept).

repeater_error_invalid_request.message: The request is not valid: fix the marked fields.

repeater_error_invalid_request_fix.message: Check the method, URL, headers and body.

repeater_error_not_attached.message: Nahual is not attached to the tab.

repeater_error_not_attached_fix.message: Attach Nahual from the session status or use the clean context.

repeater_error_context_lost.message: The tab navigated, closed or the debugger was released during the send.

repeater_error_context_lost_fix.message: Send again when the page is ready, or use the clean context.

repeater_error_network_fix.message: Check that the server responds and that the URL is right.

repeater_error_cors_blocked.message: The browser blocked the response because of CORS.

repeater_error_cors_blocked_fix.message: See the diagnosis in Traffic; you can allow CORS for development or use the clean context.

repeater_error_permission_required.message: Nahual needs access to $1 to send in clean context.

repeater_error_permission_required_fix.message: Press Send again and grant access, or use the page context.

repeater_error_permission_denied_fix.message: Without that access the clean context cannot read the response: use the page context.

repeater_error_timeout_fix.message: The server did not respond or a rule kept the request paused; try again.

repeater_error_body_too_large_fix.message: Reduce the body to 5 MB or less.

settings_origin_access.message: Access for the repeater clean context

settings_origin_access_hint.message: Origins you gave access to for sending without a session. Removing it does not affect the page context.

repeater_page_other_site.message: Page context unavailable: the tab is no longer on $1 and would send with other cookies and another origin. Go back to that site or use the clean context.

error_ignores_invalid.message: Couldn't save the ignore list. Try again; if it keeps failing, free up the extension's storage.

repeater_ignores_invalid.message: The saved list of ignored diff fields couldn't be read and was reset.

diff_side_missing.message: One of the sides is no longer available (send dropped or pasted response removed). Pick another.

diff_same_side.message: You are comparing a response with itself.

diff_failed_timeout.message: The comparison took over 10 seconds and was stopped: the responses are too large or too different.

diff_failed_invalid.message: Couldn't compare: the result was not valid.

diff_note_json_expected.message: The content-type said JSON but the body is not valid JSON: comparing by lines.

diff_note_body_not_compared.message: The body is not compared: a response is binary, over 5 MB or no longer available.

diff_note_truncated.message: There are too many differences to show them all: showing the first ones.
